text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is making her move!! Here comes 
Tokai Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Teio-san, you truly are... an incredible 
Umamusume...!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Being able to witness your revival while 
sharing the same turf today... I'm so 
blessed...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (And... that is precisely why!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Precisely because I believed that you 
would return!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I will win!! I know better than anyone!! 
I have experienced more than anyone!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(The miracle————of an Umamusume who broke 
past her limits!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus takes the lead! Ikuno Dictus! 
Ikuno Dictuuus!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――Ikuno Dictus crosses the finish line in 
first place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*――――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Aww man... I lost!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still... hehe, it feels strange—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Even before the frustration... I'm just so 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ......Welcome home.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictuuus!! Congraaatulations!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Teio, you did an amazing job!! Thank you 
so much for coming baaaack!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno----!! Teio----!! You were both super 
cool--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderful race, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot remain in such an 
embarrassing state forever, either—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Everyooone!! Thank you sooo much!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose next time, Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will win the next one too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you sure you don't want to go? You 
really, really want to celebrate both 
Ikuno and Teio, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pretty much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, yeah. I guess bringing it up 
right now would kinda kill the mood."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, Teio's already back now. We can 
meet in races anytime."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's why— I'll say what I want to say 
there myself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Then I'm heading over~! Ikuno~!! 
Teio~!! Congratulations~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...H-Hey, you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aah, jeez, who cares about being uncool?! 
Ikuno!! Teio--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm glad I got to watch today's race. 
Teio was running properly, too—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing everyone run safely really is a 
wonderful thing...――

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"...It'd be great if all the races ahead 
could stay just like this."

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
It's exciting, yet somehow warm and 
comforting――

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

Voices praising Ikuno Dictus echo 
throughout Nakayama Racecourse.

Listening to it together, we basked in the 
lingering afterglow of that miraculous 
race—
